name: Paladin · Knight style B (Crusader)
description: Dame Seraphine as a crusader knight in the plumed Knight’s style: a sleek silver sallet with a swept silver wing on its side and a gold brow band, her face showing (blue eye), polished silver plate under a white crusader tabard with a gold cross and gold belt, a gold-rimmed pauldron, a white veil from under the helm and a long white cape lined in gold that streams and ripples like the Knight’s red one. She carries a silver-and-gold warhammer low before her, its head haloed in holy light (a shimmering rim and a circling mote). Her smite draws the hammer back low, hoists it overhead, swings it over the top in a gold smear and brings it down on frame 19 in a broad gold-to-white-hot crescent, with a pillar of light falling on the foe ahead, a white flash and rays bursting from the impact and a shock along the ground; then the pillar breaks into white-hot sparks and she recovers. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material), hue-shifted ramps; the halo and the smite light glow at night.
